sql: WITH t AS ( SELECT upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) AS series, upper(market_ticker) AS mkt, pnl::numeric / quantity * 100 AS c, CASE WHEN coalesce(side,'no')='no' THEN 100 - assumed_price ELSE assumed_price END::numeric AS entry_c FROM paper_trades WHERE status IN ('settled','closed_sl') AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins) AND upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) IN ('KXNFLSPREAD','KXMLBSPREAD','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWTI','KXMLBHR','KXALBUMEQUIV','KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXINXU') ), k AS ( SELECT series, mkt, c, entry_c, CASE WHEN split_part(mkt,'-',2)='' THEN mkt ELSE series||':'||split_part(mkt,'-',2) END AS c_old, CASE WHEN series IN ('KXFEDMENTION','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXTRUMPSAYCOMPANY','KXTRUMPSAYMONTH','KXWCATTEND','KXWCFIRSTSONG','KXWCMENTION') THEN mkt WHEN split_part(mkt,'-',2)='' THEN mkt ELSE series||':'||split_part(mkt,'-',2) END AS c_new FROM t ), co AS (SELECT series, c_old AS g, sum(c) AS s FROM k GROUP BY 1,2), cn AS (SELECT series, c_new AS g, sum(c) AS s FROM k GROUP BY 1,2), ao AS (SELECT series, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s<0) AS l FROM co GROUP BY 1), an AS (SELECT series, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s<0) AS l FROM cn GROUP BY 1), tr AS ( SELECT series, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT mkt) AS mkts, round(avg(entry_c),1) AS entry, round(avg(c),3) AS mean_c, round(sum(c)/100,2) AS total_usd, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE c<0)/count(*),2) AS loss_rate, round(avg(c) FILTER (WHERE c>0),3) AS avg_win, round(abs(avg(c) FILTER (WHERE c<0)),3) AS avg_loss FROM k GROUP BY 1) SELECT tr.series||'|'||tr.n||'|'||tr.mkts||'|'||tr.entry||'|'||tr.mean_c||'|'||tr.total_usd ||'|'||tr.loss_rate||'|'||coalesce(tr.avg_win::text,'NA')||'|'||coalesce(tr.avg_loss::text,'NA') ||'|'||ao.n||'|'||ao.l||'|'||an.n||'|'||an.l AS row FROM tr JOIN ao ON ao.series=tr.series JOIN an ON an.series=tr.series ORDER BY tr.series
